sql.ahj.permit.detailByAhj: SELECT p.*, ahj.metro_area_id, ahj.name as ahj_name, cs.state_id, s.state AS "stateName", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 1 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS submissionContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 6 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS followUpContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 4 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS submissionLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 5 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS followUpLinks FROM brs.ahj_permit p INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = p.ahj_id LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ahj.company_state_id left join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE p.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.permit.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit(ahj_id, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id) VALUES(:ahjId, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.permit.searchAhjsByState: SELECT p.id, p.ahj_id FROM brs.ahj_permit p INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = p.ahj_id LEFT JOIN flow.list_of_value lov ON lov.id = ahj.metro_area_id left join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ahj.company_state_id WHERE cs.state_id = :stateId AND ahj.archived IS FALSE
sql.ahj.permit.link.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit_link(ahj_permit_id, name, link, username, password, notes, link_type_id,date_created, created_by_id,date_modified, modified_by_id) VALUES (:ahjPermitId, :name, :link, :username, :password, :notes, :linkTypeId, now(), :currentUser, now(), :currentUser)
sql.ahj.permit.link.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET ahj_permit_id = :ahjPermitId, name = :name, link = :link, username = :username, password = :password, notes = :notes, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.link.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
